name: claim2_transfer_turb
comment: Claim 2: the lab gets better at research, not only at one problem. A new problem (turbulence) for every arm; the warm arms carry knowledge from the coast swarm arm of claim1_coast with the same seed, so run claim1_coast first (warm arms wait until their source run has finished). Compare warm against fresh and cheat_sheet; compare warm_shuffled against warm_notebook (both carry a notebook and no playbook, so only the notebook's content differs).

arms.name: cheat_sheet
arms.comment: No notebook, no playbook; instead a fixed text of about a playbook's length with the candidate interface and this problem's input and sandbox sections. Controls for familiarity with the code interface.

arms.name: warm
arms.comment: The claim: the coast run's notebook and playbook.

arms.name: warm_notebook
arms.comment: Added comparator for warm_shuffled: the real coast notebook, no playbook.

arms.name: warm_shuffled
arms.comment: The coast notebook with outcomes shuffled across findings (no playbook): does the content of memory matter or only its presence?
